title: A content worker records a choice its goal leaves open (DER, UNK or drop) as a provisional gate before it commits
goal: A content item whose goal offers alternatives (rewrite as DER, mark UNK, or drop) gets the worker's choice recorded as a provisional gate on its branch, named in its report, so the orchestrator does not resume the worker to record it as BG-oi3ncidh's needed

run:
import re
files = ['agents/worker.md', 'skills/item/SKILL.md']
hits = [(f, n) for f in files for n, line in enumerate(open(f, encoding='utf-8'), 1)
        if re.search(r'alternative', line, re.I) and 'UNK' in line and 'DER' in line and 'provisional' in line.lower()]
assert hits, 'no worker rule line names the alternatives of a goal (DER, UNK, drop) as provisional-gate choices'

notes: SP-xt4t63xw retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator. Evidence: BG-oi3ncidh's worker dropped the unstated reading with no gate; the orchestrator resumed its session (claude -p --resume) to add and answer g1 before the landing.
